## Install

1. Download **hypertag-*.zip** below and unzip it into a folder you'll keep (Chrome loads the extension from that folder).
2. Open `chrome://extensions` and turn on **Developer mode** (top right).
3. Click **Load unpacked** and select the unzipped folder (the one containing `manifest.json`).
4. Refresh any open x.com tabs.

**Updating:** download the new ZIP, replace the folder's contents, then click ↻ on Hypertag in `chrome://extensions` and refresh x.com.

Full guide: https://github.com/hypertagcoin/hypertag#install
